column2: Paano mag-filter ng range gamit ang BETWEEN?
column4: SELECT * FROM orders WHERE total BETWEEN 100 AND 500; — kasama ang 100 at 500

column2: Paano mag-check ng multiple values gamit ang IN?
column4: SELECT * FROM users WHERE status IN ('active', 'pending'); — kung ang value ay nasa list

column2: Paano mag-search ng pattern gamit ang LIKE?
column4: SELECT * FROM users WHERE name LIKE '%john%'; — ang % ay wildcard para sa any characters

column2: Paano mag-combine ng conditions gamit ang AND/OR?
column4: SELECT * FROM users WHERE age > 18 AND status = 'active'; — parehong conditions ay dapat true
SELECT * FROM users WHERE email IS NULL; — huwag gumamit ng = NULL, gumamit ng IS NULL
